skills.title: Jailbreak-Proof System Prompts
skills.desc: If you're shipping AI products, adversarial users will try to break your prompts. Learn the full attack surface and how to build defences that actually hold.

skills.title: System Prompts
skills.desc: Most AI products misbehave because the system prompt is a loose list of rules rather than an architectural foundation. Build them properly here.

skills.title: AI Content Pipeline
skills.desc: Manual content creation doesn't scale. A pipeline lets one person do the work of a content team — research to draft to published with AI at every step.

skills.title: Cost-Optimised Model Routing
skills.desc: You don't need GPT-4o for a yes/no question. Smart routing cuts your API bill by 60–80% while keeping quality exactly where it matters.

skills.title: RAG: Retrieval-Augmented Generation
skills.desc: LLMs don't know your documents. RAG fixes that without fine-tuning — connect your knowledge base directly to any AI workflow in under an hour.

skills.title: Agent Memory Architecture
skills.desc: Stateless agents forget everything. Add memory and they become exponentially more useful — handling long projects, user preferences, and cross-session context.

skills.title: Few-Shot Prompting
skills.desc: Give the model 2–3 examples and watch output quality jump. One of the highest-ROI prompting techniques used by every serious AI practitioner.

skills.title: Chain-of-Thought Prompting
skills.desc: Force the model to reason step-by-step before committing to an answer. Significantly improves accuracy on maths, logic, and multi-step reasoning tasks.

skills.title: Prompt Chaining for Complex Tasks
skills.desc: Break multi-step problems into sequential prompts where each output feeds the next. Reduces hallucinations, keeps complex workflows auditable at every stage.
